title: PlasmoParrots
description: Your parrots heard everything. Now they're repeating it. Poorly. And loudly. 🦜

![Parrot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12bbc754d8312d7c798de8d4ea9e7186c9a53a48.webp)
# PlasmoParrots

**PlasmoParrots** is a Paper plugin for Plasmo Voice that lets nearby parrots mimic real player speech.

When players talk through Plasmo Voice, parrots can steal short fragments of what was said and replay them back as squeaky, toy-like chirps from their own positions.

Unlike traditional soundboard-style plugins, parrots never generate text or use pre-recorded voice lines. Every sound comes directly from real player speech.

## Features

* Mimics real nearby Plasmo Voice speech.
* Multiple parrots can respond at once.
* High-pitched, toy-like voice effects.
* Stutters, chirps, squawks, and chaotic parrot-style repeats.
* Separate **Parrots** volume slider in the Plasmo Voice menu.
* Fully positional voice playback from each parrot.

## Requirements

* Paper 1.21.4+
* Java 21
* Plasmo Voice 2.1.9+

## Commands

* `/plasmoparrots status`
* `/plasmoparrots reload`
* `/plasmoparrots debug on|off`

Aliases:

* `/pparrots`
* `/parrots`

## Permissions

* `plasmoparrots.admin`
* `plasmoparrots.reload`

Give your parrots a voice — and regret teaching them to listen.
